spread: sample standard deviation ddof1; compare matched practice seeds using larger method/base spread
collapse: any seed below half the base success on the same seed
eligibility: Normal camera only, learning methods with neither handwritten search nor hidden information, excluding all PhaseF methods; reused plain movement remains fallback/reference.
aim_working: Five development seeds; mean success exceeds61.4percent by more than own sample spread AND paired successful-episode mean guess error decreases from initial guess to first success.
aim_metric: L2 error in millimetres. Report overall start and success; compare success to start on the same successful episodes. No success yields null, never a substituted endpoint.

phase_a.fit_data: own saved counted practice only, every tenth valid step, raw16 readings with first-reading padding
phase_a.purpose: diagnosis only; old confirmation seeds never choose followup settings

report_rule: Preserve every existing report byte; only append one pointer paragraph atPhaseG as explicitly requested.
cache_rule: All new output/cache files under results/takehome/followup; never run old report/accounting/status writers.
